leads_family_status: ACCEPTED + EVALUATED (browser_capture provenance) — SW-011/012/015 land from this family as of the Gate 4A promotion

strict_evaluated_predicate.note: status=evaluated is legal ONLY when every clause holds; otherwise status=unresolved. Unresolved rows remain in the 885 ledger but DO NOT count toward completion.

confidence_model.basis: denominator sample size (missing != zero); operator-defined target certainty
confidence_model.note: Small held-family weekly samples yield low/medium confidence honestly; a firing rule on n<15 is a low-confidence signal, not a certainty.

rating_model.note: rating compares the observed value to the operational target given the metric direction. rank is the 1..3 position of this dealer among the three rooftops for the same metric (best-first by direction).

delivery_envelope.note: SCHEMA_CONTRACT §1 — scheduled lineage MUST carry + validate these; message ids are never fabricated; gmail_attachment_id absence is encoded as 'unavailable'.
delivery_envelope.period_binding: reporting_period is derived + validated from the committed period_hint (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD), never hardcoded

semantic_validation.note: Every evaluated row is validated by RECOMPUTING value/numerator/denominator/source_fields/formula/baseline/variance/rating/rank/confidence from the accepted held bundle + cohort + registry + canonical spec, and by BINDING every lineage field to the admitted delivery envelope. Presence alone is insufficient.
rejects: value inconsistent with numerator/denominator or with the recomputed candidate
baseline id/basis/value/unit/comparator/direction mismatch, blank definition, or unverified benchmark
lineage sha / filename / dealer / period / sender / subject / message-id / period_hint mismatch

SW-011.formula: median(Actual Response Time (Min) where Originated After Hours=No, numeric only)
SW-011.numerator_field: coverage: count(numeric Actual Response Time within business-hours population)
SW-011.reconciliation: value = median in minutes (NOT a ratio); blanks stay missing and are excluded; coverage numeric + business-hours population + missing count + footnote persisted in evaluation_detail

SW-012.formula: count(First Contact Attempt blank AND First Customer Contact blank AND Actual Response Time blank where Originated After Hours=No) / business_hours_population
SW-012.reconciliation: count/denominator/rate/threshold persisted in evaluation_detail; every source period ended before capture so each qualifying row is >30 min old; trigger any count > 0

SW-015.formula: count(rep mean Actual Response Time >= 2 x store median) / reps_with_numeric_response
SW-015.numerator_field: count(Sales Reps whose mean response >= 2x store median)
SW-015.reconciliation: store median = SW-011 population; reps_with_numeric + triggered count/share + triggered-rep sample-size distribution + max rep mean persisted in evaluation_detail; Sales Rep aggregated in-memory and NEVER persisted as a name; trigger any rep >= 2x

SW-031.reconciliation: computed rate must equal the source 'Appts Set %' TOTAL cell within 1e-6
